title: Moçambique reforça sua estratégia de expansão do registo civil
why: Integrated birth registration campaign where the BI is issued on the spot from the registrar's electronic data via interoperability of the two services (levels 2-3).

title: INAGE, IP Lidera Implementação da Plataforma de Interoperabilidade Centrada no Cidadão
why: DNIC and DNRN named as the identity data sources to be interoperated on the government platform (level 1 planned link).

title: ICT Legal and Regulatory Framework for the Development of Digital Identity in Mozambique
why: Next steps on data exchange between birth certificate, BI and other identity systems (level 1).

title: Projecto de Governação e Economia Digitais (EDGE, P172350) Missão de Apoio à Implementação, Aide Memória
why: Birth-registration/ID interoperability named a priority use case; X-Road to integrate DNRN and DNIC; no process to integrate DNIC and DNRN data (levels 1 and 0).

title: Moçambique vai introduzir o SIRCEV, um sistema de partilha institucional de dados de B.I
why: World Bank-funded SIRCEV to share BI data in real time between Justice and Interior; in test preparation (level 1).

title: Sistema de Identidade Civil Electrónica à luz da nova Lei de Identificação Civil
publisher: Ministério do Interior, Direcção Nacional de Identificação Civil
why: States as a challenge to operationalise SICEBI-eSIRCEV interoperability to reuse birth data for BI issuance (levels 0-1).

title: Working conceptual model of citizen identification: the case of Mozambique
why: Says civil registration and civil identification run by two ministries, ID number has no interaction with the NUIC (level 0).

title: Identification and Civil Registration: A lifeline for displaced people in Mozambique
why: Birth certificates and IDs issued through a single window for 21,000 people in 2022 (one body/event, level 2).
